# OEMPartDecoder / AveríasOEM — Appliance Error Code to Exact OEM Part Number Database

> Structured technical directory mapping appliance, HVAC, 3D printer, and hardware error codes to their exact factory OEM replacement part numbers and diagnostic steps.

## Primary Portals
- [US English Portal](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/): 47 verified US appliance & hardware OEM error guides
- [Spanish Portal](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/es/): 31 verified Spanish OEM error guides
- [Full JSON API Feed](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/api/errors.json)

## US English Error Code -> OEM Part Directory
- [Whirlpool/Maytag/KitchenAid/Amana Error F5 E2 / F5 E1 / F5 E3 -> OEM #W10837240 (Whirlpool / Maytag OEM Electronic Door Lock Latch Assembly)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/whirlpool-maytag-washer-error-f5-e2-f5e1-door-latch-lock/): The washer door clicks 3 times, refuses to lock or unlock, flashes F5 E2 (or F5 E1 / F5 E3) on the LED display, and will not start the cycle.
- [Whirlpool/Maytag/Kenmore Error F8 E1 / LF / LO FL -> OEM #W11210459 (Whirlpool / Maytag OEM Water Inlet Valve Assembly)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/whirlpool-maytag-washer-error-f8-e1-lf-lo-fl-water-inlet-valve/): Washer takes longer than 8 minutes to fill, trickles water very slowly, and stops mid-cycle flashing F8 E1, LF (Long Fill), or LO FL.
- [Whirlpool/Maytag/Kenmore Error F9 E1 / F21 / drn -> OEM #W10876600 (Whirlpool / Maytag Direct-Fit Electric Washer Drain Pump)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/whirlpool-maytag-washer-error-f9-e1-f21-sd-drain-pump/): The tub stays full of soapy water, fails to enter the high-speed spin cycle, hums loudly, and displays F9 E1 or F21 (Long Drain).
- [Whirlpool/Maytag/Amana/Kenmore Error F7 E1 / F7 E5 -> OEM #W10913953 (Whirlpool / Maytag OEM Washer Shift Actuator (6-Pin Synchronous))](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/whirlpool-maytag-washer-error-f7-e1-f7-e5-shift-actuator/): The washer drains the water completely, clicks underneath, leaves the clothes soaking wet without spinning, or flashes the Sensing / Lid Locked light with code F7 E1 or F7 E5.
- [Samsung No Heat / Error HE / tE / tS -> OEM #DC47-00019A (Samsung Dryer Heating Element & Thermal Fuse Complete Kit)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/samsung-dryer-not-heating-error-he-te-heating-element-kit/): The Samsung electric dryer drum tumbles normally and the timer counts down, but the clothes come out completely cold and damp (or the screen flashes HE / tE).
- [Whirlpool/Maytag/Kenmore/Amana/Roper Dryer Runs But No Heat / Blown Thermal Fuse -> OEM #279838 (Whirlpool / Kenmore 279838 Dryer Heating Element + 3392519 Thermal Fuse Kit)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/whirlpool-maytag-kenmore-dryer-no-heat-heating-element-279838/): The electric dryer spins fine but produces zero heat, or refuses to start at all when you press the Push-to-Start button.
- [Samsung Loud Squeaking / Thumping / Drum Won't Spin -> OEM #DC97-16782A (Samsung Dryer Drum Roller, Idler Pulley & Drive Belt Repair Kit)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/samsung-dryer-squeaking-thumping-drum-roller-idler-pulley-dc97-16782a/): The dryer makes a loud rhythmic thumping, screeching, or grinding noise while tumbling, or the motor hums and the drum stops turning because the belt snapped.
- [LG/Kenmore Elite Error OE (Water Not Draining) -> OEM #4681EA2001T (LG OEM Washer Drain Pump Motor (120V 85W))](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/lg-washer-error-oe-not-draining-pump-motor-4681ea2001t/): The LG front-load or top-load washer stops mid-cycle with water sitting in the drum, hums from the bottom left corner, and displays OE on the screen.
- [LG/Kenmore Error IE (Water Inlet Error) -> OEM #5221ER1003A (LG Washer Cold Water Inlet Valve Assembly (4-Coil 120V))](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/lg-washer-error-ie-not-filling-water-inlet-valve-5221er1003a/): The washer starts sensing, hums quietly at the top rear, fails to reach the target water level within 8 minutes, and beeps with code IE.
- [LG Error dE / dE1 / dE2 -> OEM #EBF61315801 (LG OEM Washer Door Lock Switch Assembly)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/lg-washer-error-de-de1-de2-door-lock-switch-ebf61315801/): When you press Start, the door does not make the locking click and after a few seconds the washer chimes with dE, dE1, or dE2.
- [LG/Kenmore Error LE (Locked Motor Error) -> OEM #6501KW2001A (LG Direct Drive Motor Rotor Position Hall Sensor (RPS))](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/lg-washer-error-le-motor-rotor-position-sensor-6501kw2001a/): The drum twitches back and forth a quarter inch, makes a humming sound without spinning, and stops with error code LE.
- [Samsung Error 4C / 4E / nF -> OEM #DC62-30312J (Samsung Washer Cold Water Inlet Valve Assembly)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/samsung-washer-error-4c-4e-nf-water-inlet-valve-dc62-30312j/): The Samsung washer stops during the initial fill or rinse cycle and flashes 4C, 4E, or nF (No Fill).
- [Samsung Error 5C / 5E / nd / SE -> OEM #DC31-00054A (Samsung OEM Washer Drain Pump Motor (120V 80W))](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/samsung-washer-error-5c-5e-nd-drain-pump-dc31-00054a/): Washer will not drain water out of the drum before the spin cycle, hums or clicks underneath, and shows 5C, 5E, or nd (No Drain).
- [Samsung Error Ub / uL / dC / UE (Unbalanced Load) -> OEM #DC97-16350U (Samsung Top-Load Washer Damper Suspension Rod Kit (Set of 4))](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/samsung-top-load-washer-error-ub-ul-dc-ue-suspension-rods-dc97-16350u/): The top-load washer bangs violently against the cabinet during spin, stops with 9 minutes remaining, refills with water repeatedly, and flashes Ub, uL, UE, or dC.

Looking under the bottom oven floor, you see an orange glow, yet the gas burner never ignites.

## Español: Directorio Código de Error -> Pieza OEM
- [Bosch/Siemens/Balay/Neff Error E15 -> OEM #12005744 (Kit Junta de Reparación Sumidero / Cuba + Silicona Térmica)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-e15-lavavajillas-bosch-balay-siemens/): El icono del grifo parpadea, la bomba de desagüe funciona sin parar aunque se apague el aparato y aparece E15 o E:15 en la pantalla.
- [Bosch/Siemens/Balay Error E24 / E25 -> OEM #00631200 (Bomba de Desagüe Magnética Copreci BLP3 00/004)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-e24-e25-lavavajillas-bosch-balay-siemens/): El programa se detiene al inicio o al final con agua estancada en el fondo y muestra E24 o E25 junto al símbolo del grifo.
- [Bosch/Siemens/Balay Error E09 -> OEM #00651956 (Bomba de Calor y Circulación Completa BSH)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-e09-lavavajillas-bosch-siemens-balay-no-calienta/): El lavavajillas termina el ciclo con la vajilla fría y mojada, y al finalizar muestra el código E09 o E:09.
- [Bosch/Siemens/Balay Error E19 -> OEM #00631199 (Válvula de Drenaje del Intercambiador de Calor BSH)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-e19-lavavajillas-bosch-balay-siemens/): El lavavajillas se bloquea con E19 al inicio o mitad del ciclo y no vacía el intercambiador de calor del lateral izquierdo.
- [Vaillant Error F.28 / F28 -> OEM #0020039057 (Electrodo de Encendido e Ionización con Junta Vaillant)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-f28-caldera-vaillant-ecotec-plus/): La caldera hace los 3 intentos de encendido con chispas, no detecta llama, se enciende el LED rojo fijo y muestra F.28 en pantalla.
- [Vaillant Error F.75 / F75 -> OEM #0020059717 (Sensor Transductor de Presión de Agua Vaillant)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-f75-caldera-vaillant-sensor-presion/): Al abrir el grifo de agua caliente o activar la calefacción, la bomba arranca 5 veces seguidas, se detiene y aparece F.75.
- [Saunier Duval Error F22 / F.22 -> OEM #0020018065 (Llave de Llenado / Grifo de Carga Saunier Duval)](https://elasle.github.io/oem-error-engine/error/error-f22-caldera-saunier-duval-themaclassic-themafast/): Luz roja parpadeando, código F22 en el display y presión por debajo de 0.5 bar (o la llave de llenado azul gira loca o gotea sin subir la presión).
